About Me

Who I Am

I'm a 4th semester BS Artificial Intelligence student at the University of Science and Technology Bannu (USTB), Bannu, KPK, Pakistan — actively learning AI Engineering and building a strong foundation in machine learning and data science.

I've been on a structured learning journey — completing 42+ certifications from Anthropic Academy, IBM, Google, University of London, and University of Michigan, while building real Python projects through my #100DaysOfCode challenge.

Currently interning as a Machine Learning Engineer at FlyRank.ai, where I'm putting theory into practice and sharpening my skills in the real world.
